name: Lobbyist Reporting History
description:
This dataset contains a list of lobbyist reports:  Lobbyist/Client/Contract Registration (L1), Lobbyist Monthly Expenditure Report (L2), Lobbyist Client's Annual Report (L3), Lobbyist Employer Contributions (L3C), Lobbying by State and Local Government Agencies (L5) including reports that have been superseded by an amendment.

Data Coverage and Limitations: The data set covers that prior 16 years plus the current election year. Pre-2016 records are available in separate "Pre-2016 Lobbyist Compensation and Expenses by Source" and “Pre-2016 Lobbyist Employment Registrations” datasets. This is a best-effort compilation that may contain incomplete or incorrect information. Original reports remain accessible for record verification.

Descriptions attached to this dataset do not constitute legal definitions; please consult RCW 42.17A and WAC Title 390 for legal definitions and additional information regarding political finance disclosure requirements.

CONDITION OF RELEASE: This publication constitutes a list of individuals prepared by the Washington State Public Disclosure Commission and may not be used for commercial purposes. This list is provided on the condition and with the understanding that the persons receiving it agree to this statutorily imposed limitation on its use. See
RCW 42.56.070(9) and AGO 1975 No. 15.

columns.name: origin
columns.description: PDC form identifier for this report. L1 identifies lobbyist, employer and contractual arrangements. L2 is the monthly report disclosing lobbyist compensation and lobbying expenditures. L3 details employer's total annual lobbying expenditures. For complete forms and filing requirements, see https://www.pdc.wa.gov.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Submission version number for this report. When a report is amended, a new version is created that supersedes the previous version.

columns.name: amends_report
columns.description: Report number of the previous version that this amended record supersedes. Only populated for amended reports.

columns.name: amended_by_report
columns.description: Report number of the newer version that supersedes this record. Only populated for reports that have been amended.

columns.name: filer_name
columns.description: The lobbyist firm or client name as reported on the L1 form. Names remain consistent for each filer within a given election year, but may vary between years if the firm or client changes their name.

top.item: James P Justin (Government Relations Consulting Inc.)

columns.name: lobbying_for
columns.description: When the row is a lobbyist contract, this field is the name of the client the lobbyist is lobbying for. The client name corresponds to the id in the client_id field. Additionally, if the client has been contracted through another lobbyist, the value of lobbying_for will also contain (contracted by lobbyist_name) where lobbyist_name is the name of the lobbyist hired by the client. In all other cases, this field is blank.

top.item: AMERICAN CIVIL LIBERTIES UNION OF WA

columns.name: filer_type
columns.description: Indicates if the report was filed for a lobbyist firm, client, or contract.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: This ID consistently identifies a given entity across all years in PDC records.

columns.name: firm_id
columns.description: This ID consistently identifies a given lobbyist firm across all years in PDC records.

columns.name: client_id
columns.description: This ID consistently identifies a given lobbyist client across all years in PDC records. In the case of a public agency filer_type, it is the public agency's unique identifier.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Indicates the year of the report. In the case of a biennial report it is set to the start year. i.e. L-1 contracts, firm and client profiles

columns.name: receipt_date
columns.description: The date received or postmark date of the report.

columns.name: filing_method
columns.description: Indicates if the report was filed online or sent in by mail.

columns.name: report_from
columns.description: Start date of the reporting period. For L3 forms covering the entire year, this matches the report_through date. For L2 forms, this indicates the beginning of the specific period covered.

columns.name: report_through
columns.description: End date of the reporting period. For L3 forms covering the entire year, this matches the report_from date. For L2 forms, this indicates the end of the specific period covered.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Link to the original report filed with the PDC. Electronic reports include direct links. For paper reports and some electronic reports without direct links, search the PDC imaged documents dataset using filer_id, election_year, and type to locate document images.

columns.name: report_data
columns.description: Contains the official submission record in JSON format with form input data as filed by the user.
